$comment: Mail namespace (MAIL-001). English is the reference: every other language defines exactly these keys. {brand} is the hub brand from configuration; never write a brand name into a message.

layout.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
layout.automated: This message was sent automatically by {brand} because of an action on your account. Replies to this address are not read.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address for {brand}
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: Someone, hopefully you, created a {brand} account with this email address. Confirm the address to finish signing up.
verifyEmail.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account, ignore this message. Nothing will happen without the confirmation.

alreadyRegistered.subject: Your {brand} account already exists
alreadyRegistered.heading: You already have an account
alreadyRegistered.intro: Someone tried to create a {brand} account with this email address, but an account with it already exists.
alreadyRegistered.recoverHint: Forgot your password? You can set a new one:
alreadyRegistered.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this message. Your account has not changed.

recovery.subject: Reset your {brand} password
recovery.heading: Reset your password
recovery.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {brand} account.
recovery.expiry: The link works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Every session will be signed out after the reset.
recovery.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message. Your password stays the same.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new email address for {brand}
emailChange.heading: Confirm your new email address
emailChange.intro: You asked to use this address for your {brand} account. Confirm it to finish the change.
emailChange.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
emailChange.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this message. The account keeps its current address.

membershipInvitation.subject: {company} invites you to join the team on {brand}
membershipInvitation.heading: Invitation to join {company}
membershipInvitation.intro: A colleague invited you to join {company} on {brand}. Sign in with this email address and accept the invitation to become a member.
membershipInvitation.expiry: The invitation expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
membershipInvitation.ignore: If you do not expect this invitation, ignore this message. Nothing changes unless you accept it.

securityNotice.subject: Security notice for your {brand} account
securityNotice.heading: Security notice

events.login_throttled: There were several failed attempts to sign in to your account. Further attempts are slowed down for a while. Your password has not been disabled.
events.password_reset: The password of your account was reset with a recovery link, and every session was signed out.
events.password_changed: The password of your account was changed, and your other sessions were signed out.
events.email_change_requested: Someone asked to change the email address of your account. The change happens only after the new address is confirmed.
events.provider_linked: Sign-in with {provider} was connected to your account.
events.provider_unlinked: Sign-in with {provider} was disconnected from your account.

securityNotice.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password now and review your active sessions.
